examples.text: so sace ākaṅkhati, anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ, eko'pi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ, bahudhā'pi hutvā eko assaṃ, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ

30801.commentary: (VIN) tiroraṭṭhe'ti yassa vijite viharati, taṃ ṭhapetvā aññassa raṭṭhe.

examples.text: kathañ'hi nāma, bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo tiroraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ carissanti!

30803.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of tiroraṭṭha
30803.meaning1: from across the kingdom; from throughout the empire; (comm) from other kingdoms

examples.text: samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ tiroraṭṭhā tirojanapadā pañhaṃ pucchituṃ āgacchanti.

30804.commentary: (KVa) tiroraṭṭhe'ti yassa vijite viharati, taṃ ṭhapetvā aññassa raṭṭhe. (PYt) tiroraṭṭhato'ti āvāsikānaṃ raṭṭhassa aññaraṭṭhato.

30805.meaning1: foreign king; king of another country
30805.meaning2: foreign king; king of another (distant) country

examples.text: rājā'pi maṃ pasenadi kosalo jānāti tirorājāno'pi, pāyāsi rājañño evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhī, iti'pi n'atthi paro loko, n'atthi sattā opapātikā, n'atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko'ti.
atha kho soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa tirovanasaṇḍagatassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, ahañ'c'eva kho pana samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyaṃ, tatra ce maṃ samaṇo gotamo evaṃ vadeyya
tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso muñcitvā paccavekkheyya ime sālī ime vīhī ime muggā ime māsā ime tilā ime taṇḍulā'ti
santi kho pana, sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, āhārena suddhī'ti. te evam'āhaṃsu, muggehi yāpema… tilehi yāpema… taṇḍulehi yāpemā'ti.

30808.notes: (MW) a mark or marks made with coloured earths, sandal-wood, or unguents, upon the forehead and between the eyebrows, either as an ornament or a sectarial distinction; the ornament of anything (used in comp. to express greatness or distinction, e. g. trailokya-tilaka, the ornament of the three worlds, i. e. a distinguished personage)

examples.text: sabbaṃ niruttipathapāragataṃ sabuddhaṃ, buddhaṃ tilokatilakaṃ hatapāpadhammaṃ, dhammaṃ vimuttisukhadaṃ vihat'āghasaṃghaṃ, saṃghaṃ ca niccam'abhivandiya dakkhiṇeyyaṃ.

idha, bhikkhave, tam'eva bhaginiṃ passeyya aparena samayena āsītikaṃ vā nāvutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā, jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyanaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantiṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ, vilūnaṃ khalitasiraṃ valinaṃ tilak'āhatagattaṃ.

30813.meaning2: afflicted with spots; marked with stains

examples.text: daṇḍa-parāyaṇaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantaṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ vilūnaṃ khalitasiraṃ valitaṃ tilak'āhata-gattan'ti?

30814.meaning1: with a blotchy body; with mottled limbs

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, tam'eva bhaginiṃ passeyya aparena samayena āsītikaṃ vā nāvutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā, jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyanaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantiṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ, vilūnaṃ khalitasiraṃ valinaṃ tilak'āhatagattaṃ.

30815.meaning1: with a blotchy body; with mottled limbs
30815.construction:
tilaka + āhata + gatta + ī
tilakāhatagatta + ī

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, tam'eva bhaginiṃ passeyya aparena samayena āsītikaṃ vā nāvutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā, jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyanaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantiṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ, vilūnaṃ khalitasiraṃ valinaṃ tilak'āhatagattiṃ.

30816.meaning1: three characteristics (of impermanence, suffering and non-self)
30816.meaning2: three characteristics of impermanence, pain and not-self

examples.text: kasmā pan'etaṃ evaṃ āraddhan'ti ce? buddhānañ'hi cattāri ṭhānāni patvā gajjitaṃ mahantaṃ hoti, ñāṇaṃ anupavisati, buddhañāṇassa mahantabhāvo paññāyati, desanā gambhīrā hoti, tilakkhaṇ'āhatā, suññatāpaṭisaṃyuttā. katamāni cattāri?
tadā hi sattānaṃ jātijarāmaraṇāni na paññāyanti, buddhānañ'ca dhammadesanā nāma tilakkhaṇamuttā n'atthi.

30821.meaning1: sesame seed, dehusked grain, flattened grain

30822.meaning1: time when measuring sesame and dehusked rice, etc.

examples.text: telaṃ nāma tilatelaṃ sāsapatelaṃ madhukatelaṃ eraṇḍatelaṃ vasātelaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhūmija, puriso tel'atthiko telagavesī telapariyesanaṃ caramāno tilapiṭṭhaṃ doṇiyā ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ pīḷeyya.
vāsitakaṃ nāma yaṃ kiñci gandhavāsitakaṃ. piññākaṃ nāma tilapiṭṭhaṃ vuccati.

30827.meaning1: merely the size of a sesame seed; as much as a sesame seed
30827.commentary: (VINa) itthiyā aṅgajātena attano aṅgajātaṃ sabb'antimena pamāṇena ekatilabījamattam'pi vātena asamphuṭṭhe allokāse paveseti, eso paṭisevati nāma

examples.text: paṭisevati nāma yo nimittena nimittaṃ aṅgajātena aṅgajātaṃ antamaso tilaphalamattam'pi paveseti, eso paṭisevati nāma.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho. tato puriso vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena ekam'ekaṃ tilaṃ uddhareyya, khippataraṃ kho so, bhikkhu, vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho iminā upakkamena parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya, na tv'eva eko abbudo nirayo.

30835.grammar: nt loc sg of tilākhetta, comp, irreg form of tilākhettasmiṃ
30835.construction:
tilā + khetta + smiṃ > smi
tilākhetta + smi

examples.text: na hi nūn'imassa samaṇassa, tilākhettasmi pāpakā, ekapaṇṇā dupaṇṇā ca, ten'āyaṃ samaṇo sukhī.
gandhatelappadittena, dīpena tamadhaṃsinā, tilokadīpaṃ sambuddhaṃ, pūjayāmi tamonudaṃ.
tayo lokā tilokaṃ, tayo daṇḍā tidaṇḍaṃ, tīṇi nayanāni tinayanaṃ, tayo siṅgā tisiṅgaṃ. catasso disā catuddisaṃ, pañca indriyāni pañc'indriyaṃ.
sabbaṃ niruttipathapāragataṃ sabuddhaṃ, buddhaṃ tilokatilakaṃ hatapāpadhammaṃ, dhammaṃ vimuttisukhadaṃ vihat'āghasaṃghaṃ, saṃghaṃ ca niccam'abhivandiya dakkhiṇeyyaṃ.
brāhmaṇā tisatā ime, yācanti pañjalīkatā, brahmacariyaṃ carissāma, bhagavā tava santike.

30843.meaning1: having three origins; with three sources

30845.commentary: (PVa) tisahassāni sūdā hī'ti tisahassamattā sūdā bhattakārakā. te ca kho pana padhānabhūtā adhippetā, tesu ekam'ekassa pana vacanakarā anekā'ti veditabbā. tisahassāni sūdānan'ti ca paṭhan'ti.

examples.text: sātāgirā tisahassā, yakkhā nānattavaṇṇino, iddhimanto jutimanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, modamānā abhikkāmuṃ, bhikkhūnaṃ samitiṃ vanaṃ.
tisahassāni sūdāni hi, āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā, aṅkuraṃ upajīvanti, dāne yaññassa vāvaṭā.

30846.meaning2: (1000 x 1000 x 1000) of a thousand million (cakkavāḷas?)

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena samannāgato hoti, sutena… cāgena… paññāya samannāgato hoti. tassa sutaṃ hoti, dvisahasso brahmā… tisahasso brahmā… catusahasso brahmā… pañcasahasso brahmā dīgh'āyuko vaṇṇavā sukhabahulo'ti.

30847.meaning1: galactic supercluster; system consisting of three thousand worlds; (comm) consisting of one billion worlds
30847.commentary: (ANa) tisahassī mahāsahassī'ti sahassito paṭṭhāya tatiyā'ti tisahassī, sahassaṃ sahassadhā katvā gaṇitaṃ majjhimikaṃ sahassadhā katvā gaṇitattā mahantehi sahassehi gaṇitā'ti mahāsahassī. ettāvatā koṭisatasahassa-cakkavāḷa-parimāṇo loko dassito hoti. bhagavā ākaṅkhamāno ettake ṭhāne andhakāraṃ vidhametvā sarīrobhāsaṃ dassetvā sarena viññāpeyyā'ti. gaṇakaputtatissatthero pana evam'āha, na tisahassi-mahāsahassi-lokadhātuyā evaṃ parimāṇaṃ. idañ'hi ācariyānaṃ sajjhāyamuḷhakaṃ vācāya parihīnaṭṭhānaṃ, dasa-koṭisatasahassa-cakkavāḷaparimāṇaṃ pana ṭhānaṃ tisahassi-mahāsahassi-lokadhātu nāmā'ti. ettāvatā hi bhagavatā āṇākkhettaṃ nāma dassitaṃ. etasmiñ'hi antare āṭānāṭiyaparitta-isigiliparitta-dhaj'aggaparitta-bojjhaṅgaparitta-khandhaparitta- moraparitta-mettaparitta-ratanaparittānaṃ āṇā pharati.

examples.text: ākaṅkhamāno, ānanda, tathāgato tisahassi-mahāsahassi-lokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya, yāvatā pana ākaṅkheyyā'ti.

30848.meaning1: consisting of three thousand (3 x 1000); (comm) consisting of one billion (1000 x 1000 x 1000)
30848.commentary: (ANa) tisahassī mahāsahassī'ti sahassito paṭṭhāya tatiyā'ti tisahassī, sahassaṃ sahassadhā katvā gaṇitaṃ majjhimikaṃ sahassadhā katvā gaṇitattā mahantehi sahassehi gaṇitā'ti mahāsahassī.

examples.text: yāvat'ānanda, dvisahassī majjhimikā lokadhātu tāva sahassadhā loko. ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, tisahassī mahāsahassī lokadhātu.

30849.meaning1: galactic supercluster; system consisting of three thousand worlds; (comm) consisting of one billion worlds
30849.commentary: (ANa) tisahassī mahāsahassī'ti sahassito paṭṭhāya tatiyā'ti tisahassī, sahassaṃ sahassadhā katvā gaṇitaṃ majjhimikaṃ sahassadhā katvā gaṇitattā mahantehi sahassehi gaṇitā'ti mahāsahassī. ettāvatā koṭisatasahassa-cakkavāḷa-parimāṇo loko dassito hoti. bhagavā ākaṅkhamāno ettake ṭhāne andhakāraṃ vidhametvā sarīrobhāsaṃ dassetvā sarena viññāpeyyā'ti. gaṇakaputta-tissatthero pana evam'āha, na tisahassi-mahāsahassi-lokadhātuyā evaṃ parimāṇaṃ. idañ'hi ācariyānaṃ sajjhāyamuḷhakaṃ vācāya parihīnaṭṭhānaṃ, dasa-koṭisatasahassa-cakkavāḷaparimāṇaṃ pana ṭhānaṃ tisahassi-mahāsahassi-lokadhātu nāmā'ti. ettāvatā hi bhagavatā āṇākkhettaṃ nāma dassitaṃ. etasmiñ'hi antare āṭānāṭiyaparitta-isigiliparitta-dhaj'aggaparitta-bojjhaṅgaparitta-khandhaparitta-moraparitta-mettaparitta-ratanaparittānaṃ āṇā pharati.

examples.text: ākaṅkhamāno, ānanda, tathāgato tisahassī-mahāsahassī-lokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya, yāvatā pana ākaṅkheyyā'ti.
tayo lokā tilokaṃ, tayo daṇḍā tidaṇḍaṃ, tīṇi nayanāni tinayanaṃ, tayo siṅgā tisiṅgaṃ. catasso disā catuddisaṃ, pañca indriyāni pañc'indriyaṃ.
yam'pi'ssa taṃ, bhikkhave, khayasmiṃ khayeññāṇaṃ, tam'pi saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ. kā ca, bhikkhave, khayeñāṇassa upanisā? vimuttī'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ.
ko pan'āvuso, hetu ko paccayo yena anuppanno vā doso uppajjati uppanno vā doso bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī'ti? paṭighanimittaṃ ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ.

30852.meaning1: generic monk's name used in vinaya examples

30853.meaning1: name of one of Vipassī Buddha's chief disciples
30853.meaning2: name of one of Vipassī Buddha's chief disciples

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa etadahosi, ayaṃ kho khaṇḍo ca rājaputto tisso ca purohitaputto bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasanti paṇḍitā viyattā medhāvino dīgharattaṃ apparaj'akkhajātikā.

30854.meaning1: name of a monk reborn as a Brahma

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena tisso nāma bhikkhu adhunākālaṅ'kato aññataraṃ brahmalokaṃ upapanno hoti. tatra'pi naṃ evaṃ jānanti, tisso brahmā mah'iddhiko mah'ānubhāvo'ti.

30855.meaning2: name of a constellation; the faint group in the body of the Crab, γ, δ, and θ Cancri; also known as Pussa

examples.text: āyācanaṃ gāravo brahmadevo, bako ca brahmā aparā ca diṭṭhi, pamādakokālikatissako ca, turū ca brahmā aparo ca kokāliko'ti.

30857.notes: Theragāthā verse 39 (TH1.39, TH39) is attributed to him.

examples.text: gahvaratīriyo suppiyo, sopāko c'eva posiyo, sāmaññakāni kumāputto, kumāputtasahāyako, gavampati tissatthero, vaḍḍhamāno mahāyaso'ti.

30862.meaning1: names of Kassapa Buddha's pair of chief disciples; Tissa and Bhāradvāja
30862.meaning2: names of Kassapa Buddha's pair of chief disciples; Tissa and Bhāradvāja
30862.commentary: (DNa) tissabhāradvājan'ti tisso ca bhāradvājo ca. tesu tisso paññāpāramiṃ patto, bhāradvājo samādhipāramiṃ patto ahosi.

examples.text: kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tissabhāradvājaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.

30868.grammar: pron, fem loc sg of ta

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, aggivessana, yaṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadesi, vedanā me attā'ti, vattati te tissaṃ vedan'āyaṃ vaso, evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.
siyā aññena'pi pariyāyena sammā dvayat'ānupassanā'ti, iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu, siyā'ti'ssu vacanīyā.

30871.meaning1: name of two privately awakened Buddhas; Tissa and Upatissa

examples.text: bodhi mahānāmo atho'pi uttaro, kesī sikhī sundaro dvārabhājo, tiss'ūpatissā bhavabandhanacchidā, upasikhi taṇhacchido ca sikhari.

30872.grammar: card, fem nom pl of ti

examples.text: ehi sārathi gacchāhi, rathaṃ niyyādayāh'imaṃ, ārogyaṃ brāhmaṇiṃ vajja, pabbaji dāni brāhmaṇo, sujāto tīhi rattīhi, tisso vijjā aphassayi.
tisso imā, bhikkhave, sikkhā. katamā tisso? adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā.

30876.meaning1: name of the people previously living on Vepulla mountain

examples.text: tivarānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ cattārīsa vassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. tivarā, bhikkhave, manussā pācīnavaṃsaṃ pabbataṃ catūhena ārohanti, catūhena orohanti. tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhātuso upaparikkhati, āyatanaso upaparikkhati, paṭiccasamuppādaso upaparikkhati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tividh'ūpaparikkhī hoti.
yo yajati tividhaṃ yaññasampadaṃ, ārādhaye dakkhiṇeyyebhi tādi, evaṃ yajitvā sammā yācayogo, upapajjati brahmalokan'ti brūmī'ti.

30880.meaning1: three kinds of fire; three-fold fire

examples.text: yathā'pi uṇhe vijjante, aparaṃ vijjati sītalaṃ, evaṃ tividh'aggi vijjante, nibbānaṃ icchitabbakaṃ.

30881.meaning1: putting out the three fires which afflict one

examples.text: taḷākaṃ vasupūritaṃ ghammapathe, tividh'aggipiḷesita-nibbāpanaṃ, byādhi-panudana-osadhayo, pacchimasuttapavarā ṭhapitā.

30883.meaning2: in three ways; in a threefold way

examples.text: tividhaṃ kho, gahapatayo, kāyena adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti, catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti, tividhaṃ manasā adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti.

30884.meaning1: investigating in three ways; examining in three regards

examples.text: sāvatthinidānaṃ. sattaṭṭhānakusalo, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tividh'ūpaparikkhī imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalī vusitavā uttamapuriso'ti vuccati. kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sattaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

30885.meaning2: in three ways; in a threefold way
30885.commentary: (DNa) tividhena rūpasaṅgaho'ti ettha tividhenā'ti tīhi koṭṭhāsehi. (DNt) tividhenā'ti sāmanta-jappana-iriyāpatha-sannissita-paccaya-paṭisevana-bhedato tippakārena.

examples.text: tividhena rūpasaṅgaho, sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ, anidassanasappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ, anidassana-appaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ.
evaṃ vutte daṇḍapāṇi sakko sīsaṃ okampetvā, jivhaṃ nillāḷetvā, tivisākhaṃ nalāṭikaṃ nalāṭe vuṭṭhāpetvā daṇḍam'olubbha pakkāmi.
etesañ'hi pīta-odāta-kāḷa-maṅguracchavi-sāmavaṇṇ'ādi-vasena c'eva kisa thūla-rassa-dīgha-vasena ca kāyo nānā hoti, manussānaṃ viya dvihetuka-tihetuka-ahetuka-vasena saññā'pi.

30891.meaning1: seeing linking to another life with three causes

ti + dasa + ā + a
tiṃsā + a

examples.text: ime kho pan'āyasmanto, tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.

30893.construction:
ti + dasa + ā + a
tiṃsā + a

30895.construction:
ti + dasa + ti + ima
tiṃsati + ima

examples.text: tiṃsatime ito kappe, rājā āsiṃ janādhibhū, mahāpulinanāmena, cakkavattī mahabbalo.
